results.snippet:
Father Otache is the second priest who has been kidnapped from St. Margaret Parish. Father Anthony Adikwu was rescued days after he was kidnapped from the parish June 15, 2023.

Pope Leo has in the past expressed his “immense sadness” at the recent kidnappings of priests, students and members of the Christian faithful in Nigeria and Cameroon.
